description: A six-band stereo equaliser in the style of an SSL channel strip: four fixed bands with sweepable high and low pass filters either side

params.text: Sweeps a high pass filter from 16Hz up to 350Hz at 18dB per octave; fully anticlockwise takes it out of the path
A bell at 400Hz, ±15dB, narrowing as the gain moves away from flat
A bell at 2500Hz, ±15dB, narrowing as the gain moves away from flat
Sweeps a low pass filter from 22000Hz down to 3000Hz at 12dB per octave; fully anticlockwise takes it out of the path

inputs.text: The right audio input; it follows the left input when unpatched, which puts a mono source through both channels

outputs.text: The left output, after all six filters
The right output, after all six filters

notes: the four fixed bands are always in the path, flat at their centre positions. The high and low pass filters are crossfaded out entirely at the bottom of their travel

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
